items.q: out at Lentons on Airline Highway, which had Eddie Pearson, Joe Thomas, who else was in that group? I think Alvin Alcorn.

ctx.x: And we were talking about the Billy and Dee Dee Pierce audition. Yeah, well.

Well, I actually said all I had to say about that one. I also went to one out at, and this is on some of the earlier tapes, out at Lentons on Airline Highway, which had Eddie Pearson, Joe Thomas, who else was in that group? I think Alvin Alcorn.
